description: Don’t take anything personal , it may be a gap in maturity #selflove #maturity #criticalthinking
transcript: I am a communications executive and I've learned to pay attention to gaps in maturity. Gaps in maturity can severely impact the communication style between two people. And that's why I don't take anything personal. People are debilitated to a point where they cannot move to that next step of maturity. We have no expectations for how our conversation is going to end.
